map.输入花粉浓度（grains/m³）、花粉类型与天气状况，计算过敏指数（0–5）与: Enter the pollen concentration (grains/m³), pollen type and weather to compute the allergy index (0-5) and risk level
map.📖 查看「花粉浓度过敏指数 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pollen Concentration Allergy Index User Guide"
map.💡 过敏指数综合浓度分级、花粉致敏性与天气修正。雨水冲刷降低浓度，大风促使花粉扩: 💡 The allergy index combines concentration grading, pollen allergenicity and weather correction. Rain washes pollen down and lowers concentration, while strong wind disperses it and raises concentration.
map.快速计算，结果可一键复制: quick calculation; the result can be copied in one click
map.浓度分级参考通用花粉预报标准（grains/m³）: Concentration grading references general pollen forecast standards (grains/m³)
map.天气修正：降雨 ×0.4，雨后 ×0.7，大风 ×1.5，晴朗 ×1.2: Weather correction: rainfall ×0.4, after rain ×0.7, strong wind ×1.5, clear ×1.2
map.致敏系数：树木 1.3，杂草 1.3，禾本 1.0，通用 1.0: Allergenicity factors: tree 1.3, weed 1.3, grass 1.0, general 1.0
map.由多项气象因子合成 0–6 级综合指数。: A composite 0-6 index synthesized from several meteorological factors.
map.健康/运动/过敏等场景给等级提示。: Gives grade prompts for scenarios such as health/sports/allergy.
map.基础指数由温度、湿度、风等调整得出 0–6；本例综合得 4 级（中等），建议关注: The base index is adjusted by temperature, humidity, wind and more into 0-6; in this example the composite gives grade 4 (moderate); pay attention to sensitive groups and take moderate protection.
map.0–2 舒适、3–4 中等需留意、5–6 较差宜减少户外，指数随输入实时变。: 0-2 comfortable, 3-4 moderate, take note, 5-6 poor, better to reduce outdoor activity; the index changes in real time with the input.
map.按场景权重把归一化因子加总到 0–6，具体权重随指数类型（过敏/运动）不同而不同: Normalized factors are summed to 0-6 by scenario weights, and the specific weights differ by index type (allergy/sports).
map.不要。4 级属中等，仅敏感人群减少剧烈户外，全员停工通常要到 5–6 级且结合预: No. Grade 4 is moderate; only sensitive groups should reduce strenuous outdoor activity. A full work stoppage usually requires grade 5-6 combined with a warning.
map.综合花粉浓度（grains/m³）、花粉致敏性与天气状况，计算 0–5 级过敏指: Combining pollen concentration (grains/m³), pollen allergenicity and weather, it computes a 0-5 allergy index and risk level and gives protection advice for allergic people. Runs purely on the front end; data is not uploaded.
map.浓度分级 + 天气修正 + 致敏系数三重计算: Triple calculation: concentration grading + weather correction + allergenicity factor
map.花粉过敏人群出行参考: Travel reference for people with pollen allergies
map.春季树木/秋季杂草花粉季: Spring tree / autumn weed pollen season
map.哮喘鼻炎患者防护: Protection for asthma and rhinitis patients
